name: duel-6
title: The duel's phase 6 film (the third solarpunk pass, one flowing world): the front, then the contact dance in 3D as a player sees it (the duel's own camera, the HUD on, two virtual players, rose fire the player against fern water). The YOU count-in under the geode's glass vault; then one long shot of the same set with no cut: CURRENT and the world's answer in the greenhouse, through the mirror to the Tide Temple (the camera through the disc behind the pair, a ring and petals on the glass, the temple's track coming in on the beat), the golden-hour temple with its stained glass, and on through its mirror into the redwoods at dusk and their canopy village; then a fused finale's full-stage bloom and the garland banner. Scored by the geode's track (Inside the Geode) from bar 57, then the temple's and the redwoods' as the pair cross, each on the next beat at a phrase of matching energy, the tempo bridged (scripts/film.mjs lays them as the page's deck plays them, from each crossing's bridge in info.json). The front (scripts/front-cap.mjs) is laid before it.

shots.note: under the geode's glass vault: 3, 2, 1 with the YOU tell on seat 1 (rose fire), DANCE, the first swings

one shot, no cut: CURRENT in the greenhouse and the world's answer; through the mirror to the Tide Temple (the camera through the disc, ring and petals, the temple's track on the beat); the golden-hour temple, its stained glass and water, a steam; through its mirror to the redwoods at dusk, the canopy village

the Pool's last seconds (a set on the redwoods' track that danced through the geode into the Pool, so its music is the Pool's): FINALE, fire (rose, the player) and water fused, the lift out of the water, the bloom over the whole stage in rose and fern with the sun's beams behind it, the world lit; the garland banner, P1 · YOU TAKES THE SET
